recipes.name: Spicy Rum Chicken Curry inspired by Super Smash Bros.
ingredients: 200 ml water, plus more if needed
instructions: For the Prep
Cut the chicken into large pieces and transfer to a mixing bowl. Cover and set aside in the fridge until ready to use. - 2 ½ pounds chicken thighs
For the Ginger Garlic Paste
Peel and chop ginger and garlic into small chunks. Then transfer to a small food processor. - 125 g ginger - 120 g garlic

Add salt and oil then blend until a paste forms. Add a splash or two of water as needed for thinning. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside until ready to use. - 1 tsp salt - 1 tbsp neutral oil - water as needed
For the Chicken

Combine chicken and ginger garlic in a mixing bowl along with garam masala, black pepper, turmeric, coriander powder, Kashmiri chili powder, and dark rum. Mix until every piece of chicken is coated. - 2 tbsp ginger garlic paste - 2 tsp garam masala - 2 tsp black pepper - 2 tsp turmeric - 2 tsp coriander powder - 1 tbsp Kashmiri chili powder - 75 ml dark rum - For the Chicken
Cover and marinate for at least 6 hours and up to overnight. - For the Chicken
For the Curry Base

In a large pan over medium-low heat, add oil. Once shimmering, add bay leaves and cumin seeds, stirring, until the leaves are fragrant, about 1 minute. - ½ cup vegetable or mustard oil - 2 bay leaves - 1 tsp cumin seeds
Add onion and salt and cook until onions are just softened but not brown, 5-6 minutes. - of salt as needed - 1 medium red onion chopped
Meanwhile, prepare the green chilies. - 8 green chilies slit
Then add cut green chilies and cook for 1 minute, or until fragrant. - 8 green chilies slit
Add ginger garlic paste and stir to combine. - 2 tbsp ginger garlic paste
Add tomato paste and stir to combine. Cook for 2-3 minutes, or until tomato paste is darker in color. - ¼ cup tomato paste

Add coriander powder, turmeric powder, black pepper, garam masala, and Kashmiri chili powder, and stir to combine. Cook for 30 seconds, or until fragrant, then add water and stir to combine. - 2 ½ tsp coriander powder - 2 ½ tsp turmeric powder - 2 ½ tsp black pepper - 2 ½ tsp garam masala - 2 ½ tsp Kashmiri chili powder - 200 ml water plus more if needed
For the Assembly
Add the marinated chicken, stir to combine and cover with a lid. Cook for 30-45 minutes on medium low heat, or until chicken is tender. - For the Chicken
Cook basmati rice according to the package at this time. - basmati rice
Add more water if necessary to achieve preferred gravy thickness. Add optional chili powder at this time. - water as needed - ¼ cup chili powder optional - 200 ml water plus more if needed
Once the curry has reduced a bit and the chicken is cooked through, remove chilies and take the pan off the heat. - 8 green chilies slit
Add rum. Then using a long stick lighter, ignite the rum, shaking the pan to dissipate the flames. - 180 ml dark rum
Serve with basmati rice. - basmati rice
For the Flaming Version
Transfer cooked basmati rice to a heat-proof serving plate and pile chicken curry on top. - basmati rice - For the Chicken - For the Curry Base
Add rum to a small pan. Then using a long stick lighter, ignite the rum, then carefully pour the flaming rum over the plate of Chicken Curry for the ultimate spice and alcohol. - 180 ml dark rum
